nodes.name: Al substrate cleaning
nodes.procedure: Aluminum sheets were cut into small dimensions (2cm×2cm) and subjected to ultrasonic cleaning in acetone and deionized water (DI) for 3min each to eliminate surface contaminants. Subsequently, they were dried using a stream of nitrogen.
nodes.source_text: Aluminum sheets were cut into small dimensions (2cm×2cm) and subjected to ultrasonic cleaning in acetone and deionized water (DI) for 3min each... dried using a stream of nitrogen.

nodes.name: Micro-textured surface etching
nodes.procedure: The cleaned Al substrates were then immersed in an acid solution of DI water and HCl (volume ratio: 2:1) for 3min at room temperature to generate the MT surface. Following the etching process, the samples underwent ultrasonication in acetone, were rinsed with deionized water (DI), and finally, dried at 100°C for 10min.

nodes.name: Hierarchical microporous etching
nodes.procedure: The fabricated MT substrates were further etched in 5 wt% H3PO4 solution for 60 min at 50°C, followed by cleaning with DI water and dried in air to generate optimal hierarchical microporous (HMP) Al surfaces.

nodes.source_text: The fabricated MT substrates were further etched in 5wt% H3PO4 solution for different intervals of time at 50°C... Hence, the morphology of the hierarchical microporous (HMP) surface after 60min of etching presents an optimal rough surface

nodes.name: PFOTS superhydrophobic coating
nodes.procedure: The prepared Al substrates were dipped into a 0.5% PFOTS solution in n-hexane for 10min. Following immersion, the Al substrates underwent a rinse with n-hexane and were subsequently dried on a hot plate at 100°C for 20min.

nodes.description: Mechanical durability assessment via linear abrasion test
nodes.source_text: the HMP surface demonstrated remarkable resilience to abrasion, maintaining its superhydrophobic properties for up to 6 cycles (equivalent to 120 cm of abrasion). However, after 7 cycles (140 cm), the surface lost its superhydrophobicity, with the WCA and WSA decreasing from 162° to 147° and 5° to 25°, respectively.

nodes.description: Chemical stability assessment in acidic/alkaline solutions
nodes.source_text: Water with different pH values was used as corrosive liquids... the average WCA of the corrosive liquids on the superhydrophobic HMP surface remained consistently above 150° even after immersion.

nodes.description: Salt resistance test in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution
nodes.source_text: Both untreated and superhydrophobic HMP surfaces were immersed in the corrosive 3.5 wt% NaCl solution for five days... the surface maintained its superhydrophobic properties for up to four days. However, after the fourth day... average WCA of 147°... lower concentration of Cl- ions (0.34 wt%)

nodes.description: Antibacterial efficacy test against S. aureus
nodes.source_text: a 100-μL bacterial suspension (10^7 CFU/mL) was spread on agar plates... The plates were subsequently incubated at 37°C for 24 h... a distinct inhibition zone was observed around the superhydrophobic HMP-Al surface, with an average diameter of 23 mm against S. aureus

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows untreated Al surface smooth; MT surface with irregular micro-protrusions and rectangular plateaus 1-2 μm; HMP surface after 60 min etching has hierarchical micropores ~4 μm with 3-5 μm microcracks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Surface morphology analysis of the untreated, micro-textured (MT), and hierarchical microporous (HMP) Al substrates was conducted using SEM, as depicted in Fig. 2.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS of MT Al surface primarily contains Al, O, C, Mg; superhydrophobic HMP-Al after 5 days 3.5 wt% NaCl immersion shows Cl 0.34 wt% (vs 1.21 wt% for untreated Al), decreased Si and F.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EDS analysis indicated that the composition of the MT surface on the Al substrate primarily consisted of elements such as Al, O, C, and Mg, as illustrated in Fig. 2(e).

nodes.characterization_summary: Superhydrophobic HMP-Al surface exhibits WCA of 162° and WSA of 5°; maintains superhydrophobicity after 120 cm abrasion at 12.25 kPa and 4 days NaCl immersion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The superhydrophobic HMP surface obtained after 60 min of etching and followed by coating with PFOTS attained the highest WCA (162°) and the lowest WSA (5°).
